args.message:
Fix money rounding to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The nightly build fails because tests/test_money.py expects
ROUND_HALF_EVEN (2.665 -> 2.66), but src/money.py was using
ROUND_HALF_UP. Update the rounding mode to match FIN-212.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN), per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

Example: `Decimal("2.665")` now rounds to `2.66` (ties round to even), matching the FIN-212 requirement and the test expectations.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.

## Review
- Requesting review from alex (code owner approval required to merge into main).
